mapper.select:
select FILE_ID as fileId, FILE_TYPE as fileType, FILE_NAME as fileName, FILE_PATH as filePath , CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME+0 as uploadTime , UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime FROM BOK_FILE_INFO where 1=1
AND FILE_NAME like concat_ws('','%',#{fileName},'%')
AND FILE_TYPE like concat_ws('','%',#{fileType},'%')
AND CREATE_USER like concat_ws('','%',#{createUser},'%')
AND DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') >= #{uploadTimeBegin}
AND DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{uploadTimeEnd}
order by uploadTime DESC
